page_title: SAL 0-2 MON | Salernitana v Monza 24/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Michael Fabbri is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+3' A player from Salernitana brings down an opponent and commits a foul. Monza are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90' A player from Monza takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Salernitana.
87' Fabio Liverani decides to make a substitution. Antonio Candreva will be replaced by Simy (Salernitana).
83' 0 - 2 Goal! Milan Djuric gets to the ball and heads it over the defence to Matteo Pessina (Monza), who meets it nicely and fires in into the back of the net. 0:2.
82' Valentin Carboni comes off the pitch to be replaced by Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro (Monza).
81' The corner is swung in but Monza can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
81' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out. The ball goes out of play. Monza are awarded a corner kick.
78' 0 - 1 Daniel Maldini (Monza) connects with a pass inside the box and slams home into the bottom right corner. The goalkeeper was helpless.
78' Salernitana have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

77' Loum Tchaouna (Salernitana) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a sitter. His shot was directed towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him. Now Salernitana have a corner.
76' Salernitana quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
76' Jerome Boateng (Salernitana) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out. The referee signals a corner kick to Salernitana.
75' The resulting corner from Daniel Maldini (Monza) comes to nothing.
75' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out. It will be a corner kick for Monza.
73' That's the end of the game for Grigoris Kastanos (Salernitana), who is replaced by Mateusz Legowski.
73' Substitution. Toma Basic will be replaced by Boulaye Dia (Salernitana).
73' Here is a change. Armando Izzo is going off and Raffaele Palladino gives the last tactical orders to Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza).
72' Toma Basic (Salernitana) is booked.
71' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Antonio Candreva (Salernitana).

70' Grigoris Kastanos (Salernitana) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. The linesman points to the corner flag, Salernitana are going to take it.
67' Raffaele Palladino has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Luca Caldirola (Monza) replacing Pablo Mari.
67' The game has come to an end for Dany Mota. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Daniel Maldini (Monza).
66' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Monza.
66' Dany Mota (Monza) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out. The ball goes out of play and Monza have been awarded a corner kick.
63' Armando Izzo (Monza) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Michael Fabbri had an easy-decision to make.
61' Here's the change. Konstantinos Manolas leaves the pitch and Jerome Boateng (Salernitana) comes on as a substitute.
61' Fabio Liverani has decided to make a change. Loum Tchaouna (Salernitana) replaces Shon Weissman.
60' Monza failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
59' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Roberto Gagliardini (Monza). Monza have been awarded a corner kick.
57' Roberto Gagliardini (Monza) connects with the ball in the six-yard box after the resulting free kick and shoots towards goal, but Guillermo Ochoa makes a magnificent save!
57' Dany Mota (Monza) takes the corner.

56' Milan Djuric (Monza) latched on to a cross inside the six-yard box and headed at goal. If it wasn't for one of the defenders making a save on the goal line, he would have been celebrating a goal now. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Monza.
55' The resulting set piece from Salernitana is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

54' A pass lands at the feet of Grigoris Kastanos (Salernitana) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender. The ball goes out of play. Salernitana are awarded a corner kick.
53' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Salernitana comes to nothing.
53' Domagoj Bradaric (Salernitana) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball is out of play and Salernitana manage to earn a corner.

52' Armando Izzo (Monza) wastes a great chance from the resulting corner. He times his header superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross, but can't aim better than into the middle of the goal, straight into the arms of the goalkeeper.
52' The linesman makes the right call and Monza will have a corner.

51' Andrea Carboni (Monza) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Monza.
48' Pablo Mari (Monza) has tested the patience of referee Michael Fabbri and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
47' The corner from Dany Mota (Monza) is hurriedly cleared.
47' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Milan Djuric (Monza) is thwarted and cleared to safety. The referee blows his whistle, Monza are awarded a corner kick.
46' Half-time substitution. Andrea Colpani (Monza) will not participate anymore and Warren Bondo is coming on.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+1' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.

44' Milan Djuric (Monza) is ready on the edge of the six-yard box and duly receives the cross, but his header fizzes just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Salernitana will have a goal kick.
42' Poor challenge! Andrea Carboni (Monza) is penalised for tripping and Michael Fabbri blows his whistle.
41' Pablo Mari (Monza) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Michael Fabbri blows his whistle for a foul.
40' Pablo Mari (Monza) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his low effort towards the middle of the goal is comfortably saved by the goalkeeper.
40' Monza have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
39' Dany Mota (Monza) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. Corner kick. Monza will have an opportunity.
38' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Triantafyllos Pasalidis (Salernitana) was quite harsh and Michael Fabbri didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
36' Salernitana take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
36' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. Salernitana will take a corner kick.
35' Samuele Birindelli (Monza) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. Salernitana have a free kick from a promising distance.
33' Milan Djuric (Monza) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Michael Fabbri signals.
28' Shon Weissman (Salernitana) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monza.
26' Handball by Milan Djuric (Monza).
23' Roberto Gagliardini (Monza) trips an opposition player and Michael Fabbri signals a foul.
21' Salernitana can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
21' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. Salernitana have been awarded a corner kick.
19' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
18' Andrea Carboni (Monza) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
14' Roberto Gagliardini (Monza) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle.
12' Referee Michael Fabbri sees the trip by Valentin Carboni (Monza) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
12' Monza take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
11' Dany Mota (Monza) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. The ball is out of play. Monza will have a chance to score from a corner.

9' Grigoris Kastanos (Salernitana) collects a wonderful lead pass and creates some space to smash the ball goalwards from long range. His shot goes painfully wide of the left post! The ball goes out of play and Monza will have a goal kick.

6' Armando Izzo (Monza) misses a big chance from point-blank range as he struck the ball low towards the middle of the goal. His promising effort following the corner kick was, to his disappointment, thwarted by Guillermo Ochoa with a fabulous save.
6' Dany Mota (Monza) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
5' Samuele Birindelli (Monza) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender. Monza force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
5' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Dany Mota (Monza), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. Monza have a corner.
4' A player from Salernitana commits a rough challenge. Michael Fabbri blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
2' Milan Djuric (Monza) plants his close-range header just wide of the left post after a cross into the box. The ball goes out of play and Salernitana will have a goal kick.
2' Milan Djuric (Monza) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike from the penalty spot wasn't accurate enough and the ball bounced away off the left post!
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! Salernitana will take the kick-off.
Michael Fabbri will officiate today.
